result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway creates a significant crossing distance without a median refuge, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not visible.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, which can lead to confusion and unsafe crossings.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks. The environment is adjacent to a large recreational field and residential street parking, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure but lacking advanced safety features like curb extensions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb on the right side of the image may obstruct the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection along the curb

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears relatively wide, which can encourage higher vehicle speeds during right-hand turns.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Ensure pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers are installed and visible to provide clarity on remaining crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing basic infrastructure for crossing. However, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island result in a long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of asphalt without any mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Travel Lanes
hazards.description: The excessive width of the travel lanes can encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
